title: Geo add the ability to get a reference to the map instance

comments.body: another option would be to add this event to the return of `.geoSearch()`, but that would be less obvious to deal with, so adding `events` here seems nice. Maybe it can be added to other ones too if it makes sense
Have you considered having the the instance of the map as a property of the widget and documenting it?
@bobylito then it would be undefined before mounted right?

> @bobylito then it would be undefined before mounted right?

Probably indeed 😅 . Other idea: what about having a method on the widget instance that returns a promise of the map?

For anyone still wondering, a reference to the map is passed in the events from [builtInMarker](https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/geo-search/js/#widget-param-builtinmarker) and [customHTMLMarker](https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/geo-search/js/#widget-param-customhtmlmarker).
